findings.title: wrangler (worker) contains high-severity vulnerability via miniflare/sharp
findings.detail: wrangler@^4.37.0 in worker/package.json falls in the vulnerable range 4.16.0–4.130.0 (GHSA affecting miniflare and sharp transitively). Latest safe version is 4.136.3. fixAvailable: true.
findings.suggested_fix: Bump wrangler in worker/package.json from ^4.37.0 to ^4.136.3 and run npm install

findings.title: js-yaml <4.3.2 in frontend devDependencies (GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh)
findings.detail: js-yaml versions >=4.0.0 <4.3.2 are vulnerable to CPU exhaustion via empty merge sources (CVE-2025, CVSS 7.5). A transitive devDependency in frontend/. fixAvailable: true.
findings.suggested_fix: Run npm audit fix inside frontend/ to update js-yaml to >=4.3.2

findings.title: react and react-dom are one major version behind (18.x vs 19.x)
findings.detail: frontend/package.json specifies react@^18.2.0 and react-dom@^18.2.0. Latest major is 19.3.0. The current semver range will not auto-update across the major boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Update react and react-dom to ^19.3.0 in frontend/package.json and run npm install, then validate the build
